generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Register and operate tmux sessions and panes as controlled terminal and runtime surfaces, including ownership, attach and detach, pane-state and log inspection, notifications, recovery, and isolation between runs.

contract.purpose_user_function: Use named tmux sessions/windows/panes as the primary local agent cockpit and physical-operator surface, with pane assignment, controlled dispatch, status capture, blocker detection, notifications and recovery hygiene.
contract.valid_inputs: Session/window/pane targets, runtime/profile/model configuration, task/sprint dispatch files, pane output, operator registry entries, attach/detach/start/stop commands and explicit control actions.
contract.expected_outputs: Created or reused isolated tmux sessions/panes, assignments and titles, dispatched commands, captured logs/state, runtime/blocker classification, notifications, recovery results, and status artifacts.
contract.state_side_effects: Creates/kills/respawns/selects/attaches/detaches tmux sessions or panes, sends commands, writes assignments/runtime events and hygiene state, and may update operator cooldown/block state.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing tmux/session/pane is surfaced; busy, auth/quota/modal or unsafe pane state prevents dispatch; capture verification failure records a failed dispatch; ownership/hygiene rules prevent unsafe reuse/teardown.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: tmux is a POSIX/WSL terminal surface, not native Windows. Private model reasoning is not observable; only pane text, events, assignments and artifacts are evidence.
contract.success_evidence: harness/coordinator.sh: tmux dispatch/capture and runtime_status_transition; harness/lib/symphony/status-server.py: _pane_snapshot/_main_screen; tests/harness/test_no_direct_tmux_send_keys.py; tests/harness/test_tmux_notification_bridge.py. The former d5 path-escape probe is quarantined because it writes to the real user home and is not accepted evidence.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Session create/existing/absent; pane ownership/isolation; attach/detach; literal dispatch and verification; busy/modal/auth/quota blocker; capture/log inspection; notification; crash/recovery/respawn; cleanup without cross-run teardown; Windows/WSL path.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md: four-pane tmux cockpit and Platform Support; INSTALL.md: live-harness requirements and solar harness preflight; docs/FIRST-SESSION.md: Open The Cockpit And Submit Work.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: solar harness start/stop/status; harness/coordinator.sh; harness/coordinator-watchdog.sh; status-server pane APIs; tmux CLI as external runtime dependency.
contract.config_schemas: harness/config/actor-hosts.schema.json: tmux_pane host type/meta; harness/config/physical-operators.schema.json: physical backend/session/window/pane_ref; harness/config/multi-task-profiles.json.
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/coordinator.sh dispatch and pane helpers; harness/coordinator-watchdog.sh recovery; harness/lib/symphony/status-server.py _run_tmux/_pane_snapshot/_main_screen; harness/lib/cli/solar_ui_lite.py collect_runtime.
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Requires Bash/tmux on macOS, Linux or WSL2; agent runtime processes still require external Codex/Claude authentication and quota; terminal capture is heuristic evidence.
